headline_marked: At least 14 injured in [[Jubo Dal-Chhatra Dal clashes]] in Dhaka’s New Market
headline: At least 14 injured in Jubo Dal-Chhatra Dal clashes in Dhaka’s New Market
summary: The violence erupted over alleged extortion from footpath vendors and control of the area near Balaka Cinema Hall.
details: At least 14 people were injured in clashes between activists of Jubo Dal’s New Market unit and Chhatra Dal members from Dhaka College in the New Market area on Tuesday evening.
The conflict broke out around 7:30 PM near Balaka Cinema Hall, reportedly triggered by alleged extortion from footpath vendors and disputes over area control.
Witnesses stated that the incident began when Jubo Dal activists attempted to collect money from vendors, which was resisted by Dhaka College Chhatra Dal members.
The situation escalated into a violent attack involving 40-50 people using sticks and knives, followed by counter-attacks and vandalism in the Bashundhara Goli area near Priyangan Market.
Eight injured individuals from the Dhaka College side, including Joint Convener Prince Khandaker, were identified, while six from the Jubo Dal side were also injured.
The injured were treated at Popular Hospital in Dhanmondi and later moved to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH).
Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam confirmed the clashes and stated that the situation was brought under police control by 11:30 PM.
Police are currently investigating the incident to take further legal action.
caption:

Dhaka Metropolitan Police’s Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam confirmed the clashes and stated that the situation was brought under police control by 11:30 PM.

headline_marked: 10 injured as [[JnU bus attacked by locals]] in Manikganj
headline: 10 injured as JnU bus attacked by locals in Manikganj
summary: The attack occurred in Singair upazila after a dispute over overtaking an auto-rickshaw, leaving students and the driver hurt.
details: A bus carrying students of Jagannath University (JnU) was attacked by local people in Singair upazila of Manikganj yesterday afternoon, leaving at least 10 students and the driver injured.
The incident took place at Bandakshin Bazar in Singair when the university's 'Kaliganga' bus was traveling toward Manikganj.
University officials reported that two students sustained serious injuries, including one with a head injury and another hurt by shattered glass.
According to JnU transport administrator Dr Tarek Bin Atiq, the clash began after the bus tried to overtake an auto-rickshaw and some students allegedly pushed the driver when he did not give way.
Singair Police Station OC Md Mazharul Islam stated that locals may have mistaken the university bus for a vehicle involved in a separate road accident that had occurred on the same road.
The injured were given preliminary treatment at hospitals in Manikganj and Singair, and the university is currently in the process of filing a case against the attackers.
caption:
10 students and a driver injured after a Jagannath University bus was attacked by locals in Manikganj.

A bus carrying students of Jagannath University (JnU) was attacked by local people in Singair upazila of Manikganj yesterday afternoon, leaving at least 10 students and the driver injured.

The incident took place at Bandakshin Bazar in Singair when the university's 'Kaliganga' bus was traveling toward Manikganj.

University officials reported that two students sustained serious injuries, including one with a head injury and another hurt by shattered glass.

According to JnU transport administrator Dr Tarek Bin Atiq, the clash began after the bus tried to overtake an auto-rickshaw and some students allegedly pushed the driver when he did not give way.

Singair Police Station OC Md Mazharul Islam stated that locals may have mistaken the university bus for a vehicle involved in a separate road accident that had occurred on the same road.

The injured were given preliminary treatment at hospitals in Manikganj and Singair, and the university is currently in the process of filing a case against the attackers.
